_doc: Thính Vũ Lâu cast, part 2: the dead of the lineage, then the Trúc Cơ.

people.gloss: The rain on the Tiêu and Tương rivers
people.cause: died at 640 in her third attempt on Hóa Thần, by the lotus on Tàn Hà Hồ
people.role: Founder of Thính Vũ Lâu (year 380, at 140); hung the first rain-chain and kept the withered lotus
people.appearance: Remembered as a slight woman under a spotted-bamboo umbrella, who would stop speaking in the middle of a sentence when it began to rain.
people.backstory: Phó Tiêu Tương was born in 240 on Tương Phi Đảo, the isle of the spotted bamboo, where the sea rain comes in sideways, and her root was Water and Metal: rain on bronze. She wandered the south for a century. In 380, at 140, she raised a tower on the cone above the rain forest of Tiêu Vũ Lâm (C006), because from that height she could hear rain fall on the whole forest at once. She hung a bronze rain-chain from its eaves (N-thinh_vu-01) and kept the withered lotus on the lake below to hear the rain on it (A266). When Khải Lôi fell in 480 the Tower took its mountains (C008), and she took in the drummer's boy Nhiếp Văn Lôi (nhiep_van_loi) and let him write the thunder into her chain (N-thinh_vu-03). She fought Lạc Hà for the Petal Shore (C126, C128), then swore with Lạc Hà's founder Nhan Cô Vụ (nhan_co_vu) to end the Pivot's oversight (C155), and lost the War of Broken Halberds at Chiết Kích Nguyên (C017). She signed the truce (C018) and spent her last seventy-five years beside the lake. She died there in 880 (C164) and was sunk in it under the lotus.

people.backstory: Nhiếp Văn Lôi was born in 466 at Kích Cổ Đường, where Khải Lôi's drummers answered the thunder. When the Gate fell (C008) the drummers scattered (V153), and the boy of sixteen walked up the cone with the storm notes in his head (N-thinh_vu-02). Phó Tiêu Tương (pho_tieu_tuong) took him in. On Văn Lôi Đài he wrote the Văn Lôi Kinh (N-thinh_vu-03), and he set the first listeners in the inns of the south. He died at Chiết Kích Nguyên in 803 (C017), holding the ground while the founder withdrew.

people.backstory: Diêu Trảm Hoa was born in 470 in Không Mông Thành, ten years before Khải Lôi's city passed to the Tower (C056, C008). He was the founder's war captain in the War of the Petal Shore (C126). He took Hồng Vũ Thành and would not leave it when the orchards were set burning, and he died in the city in 618 (C127). His disciples say the red rain that fell was his. The Pivot's judgement gave the Tower the forest he had held (C128).

people.backstory: Văn Hải Khô drained the qi wells of three river towns in the west before he was driven out of them. He came to the Tower by night at the Night Rain Edict (C196) with his scripture as his price, and Mạnh Dạ Vũ (manh_da_vu) made him a guest elder. He died in seclusion in 951. The Tower recorded a qi deviation, and his scripture passed to the head.

people.backstory: Tạ Thiết Trụ was born in 880 at Lôi Tinh Khoáng, the thunder-crystal mine of the ridge, and his Thunder let him stand under a strike. Lệ Tiêu Hồn (le_tieu_hon) gave him Thủ Lôi Bảo, the guard above Kinh Lôi Mạch. When Phượng Minh's disciples came in 1042 (V161) he held it for nine days and burned with it. The Tower built its new guard higher on the ridge, on Thần Cổ Phong, and named the guardhouse for him (N-thinh_vu-07).

people.backstory: Kỷ Vãn Tình was born in 900 in Thu Trì Thành, a ferryman's daughter with a Water root and a temper. She was Mạnh Dạ Vũ's (manh_da_vu) Dao partner for two hundred years, though the Tower never named it, and the mother of Mạnh Lưu Ly (manh_luu_ly). At Đan Sơn Mạch, when Thiên Xu came in on Phượng Minh's side (C189), the head gave her the rear guard and told her to hold the pass until the column was through. She sent four people out with the wounded and held it until the Pivot's arrays closed in 1156 (N-thinh_vu-08).

people.role: Thunder prodigy of the inner gate, born under the new seat; Hầu Vọng Xuân's disciple, courted by Mạnh Lưu Ly
people.appearance: A wiry young woman with gold dust still in the creases of her knuckles and hair that stands up a little before a storm.
people.backstory: Khúc Thanh Điện was born in 1150 at Sa Kim Khoáng, the gold-sand mine below Thần Cổ Phong, sixteen years before the Tower's halls came up the ridge. Her mother washed gold in the stream, and her father hauls ore for Xuyên Lâm Môn, which holds the mine. Lightning struck the washing shed when she was six, and the girl inside was found sitting up and laughing: that was her Thunder forming. Hầu Vọng Xuân (hau_vong_xuan) took her at twelve, one of the first disciples from the new seat's own ridge, and drove her hard. At fifty she holds a sword raised to the cloud longer than anyone in the inner gate (A316). In 1197 Mạnh Lưu Ly (manh_luu_ly) began to come to her drills, bringing glass from Tử Tinh Khoáng and teaching her to listen to rain the way the head does. Hầu has noticed. Her little brother entered the outer gate in 1199.
people.wants: To be the best Thunder sword in the Tower, and to choose her own master, which the Tower does not allow.
people.secret: Her father is Xuyên Lâm Môn's informer at the mine. For three years she has passed him the dates of the Tower's storm drills, and she knows that Úc Diệp Thanh reads them.

people.gloss: He who listens to the cicadas
people.role: The head's last disciple, blind from birth; a root like the head's own
people.appearance: A thin young man with milky eyes, who turns his whole body toward whoever speaks and plucks a qin with three strings missing.
people.backstory: Ung Thính Thiền was born blind in 1170 in Hạnh Hoa Thị, below the old tower, to a family that sells apricot blossom after rain (A290). At nine he could name every bird in the market by its call and every stall-keeper by their walk. The healer Giả Hồi Xuân (gia_hoi_xuan) tried his eyes and said there was nothing wrong with them except that they did not see. Mạnh Dạ Vũ (manh_da_vu), on one of his rainy-season visits to Văn Lôi Đài, heard of him, sat beside him in the market for a night of spring rain, and took him as his disciple in 1186, the first he had taken in a century. The boy's root is the head's own, Water and Metal without Thunder, and the Tower drew its conclusions. He reached Trúc Cơ at twenty-nine, fast for a root of two. He hears the life lamps hum in the vaults through two hundred feet of rock.
people.wants: To hear the founder's chain ring on the old tower once, as the head says it did in her day, and not to be anybody's weapon against Mạnh Lưu Ly.
people.secret: Among the four thousand lamps in the vaults he can hear one burning to the note of the head's own breath. The vault law says a head has no lamp. He has told no one.

He keeps the stores' ledgers and counts everything, which is what Doãn Ngọc Hành's (doan_ngoc_hanh) envoys pay him for: the count of 1165 (C200) was his. Nhiếp Vô Thanh has known since 1166. He does not know she knows, only that he is still alive.

people.backstory: Úc Đả Diệp was born in 1140 at Xuyên Lâm Môn, the staff-fighters' gate that guides travellers through the rain forest (A289) and refused the arts of the Night Rain Edict (A292). When the Tower set its new seat on Thần Cổ Phong among Xuyên Lâm's mines, the Gate protested, and in 1170 its head Úc Diệp Thanh (uc_diep_thanh) sent his nephew to the seat as surety (N-thinh_vu-11). He was thirty. He has been taught nothing of the lineage, keeps to his staff, and has become the best-liked man in the inner gate.

Đàm has followed her up the ridge, through two breakthroughs that failed and one that did not, and through every quarrel with the Thunder Hall. She rings the evening bell at the new seat. She carries Lưu Ly's letters, and in 1157 she read one.

He rings the bronze bell for the Kinh Trập Bell Test every spring: an outer disciple whose Metal has reached 45 hears the bell answer inside their own chest and walks inward. He has rung it for eighty springs and remembers the year it did not answer him.

people.backstory: Tôn Tuyệt Bích was born in 1120 at Lôi Tinh Khoáng, the thunder-crystal mine whose seams carry no thunder at all, and his root is the same: Metal and Earth, no Fire. Cố Dạ Lan (co_da_lan) took him in 1170, the year the halls came to the ridge, because he had climbed Tuyệt Bích Phong at twelve without a rope. He has fought thirty-one duels with outsiders and lost two. He keeps the two winners' names on his sleeve.

people.appearance: A quiet woman with ink-stained cuffs, who sheathes her sword before she bows.
people.backstory: Diệp Ẩn Thư was born in 1130 in Bình Dã Trấn, the plain in the forest where it rarely rains (A267). In 1150 she found one book in a wall cupboard of empty Trúc Ẩn Viện, left behind when its masters walked north at the Night Rain Edict (V146): a righteous sword manual. She has read it every night since, and her sword has grown gentler than the Tower likes. Tưởng Lậu Thanh suspects. Nhiếp Vô Thanh (nhiep_vo_thanh) knows.

people.backstory: Warden of the rain-flower mine (A286) since the guard moved up to it after the storm of 1102 (V162); he sends every pebble shaped like a flower to the old tower. He sends the youngest boys into the flooded seam first and counts the pebbles, not the boys; one came up with a drowned cough that has not left him.

ties.note: the war elder keeps the mines' guards
a mine boy
picks rain-flower pebbles from the stream at Vũ Hoa Khoáng
his niece; sorts the rain-flower pebbles at Vũ Hoa Khoáng

people.appearance: Holds each flower-stone up to the light before sorting it; pebble-dust on his sleeves.

people.role: Keeps the water clock at night for the Hall of Rules
people.backstory: Tưởng Lậu Thanh's (tuong_lau_thanh) night clerk, who sits by the water clock until dawn and reports every lamp he sees lit.

ties.note: the Hall of Rules
a quiet outer-gate boy
keeps the water clock's cistern full at night
reader of the Hall of Rules: keeps the sect rules and reads the charge at trials

people.appearance: Cocks his head at drips, and carries a bruise-coloured under-eye from the night watch.

people.role: Runner for the Hall of Echoes on the ridge
people.backstory: Born at Ngân Lộ Khoáng below the old tower and carried east in 1166; she runs messages between the Hall of Echoes and its ears along the ridge road.

ties.note: the Hall of Echoes
watches him for her master and has not been told why
runner for the Hall of Echoes between the ridge and Hạnh Hoa Thị

people.appearance: Blows a reed whistle on a thong before she turns a corner.

people.role: Thunder Hall guard on Kinh Lôi Mạch
people.backstory: A Hạnh Hoa boy whose Thunder formed on the cone; he walks the Iron Rain chain from the seat to the vein each night for Lệ Tiêu Hồn (le_tieu_hon). He once hung a fellow guard out over the vein's edge for a night, to see if his Thunder would show.

ties.note: the vault master
they share the night watch
draws the bronze wire for the Iron Rain chain at the storm forge
holds the outer door of the soul vaults under Kinh Lôi Mạch

people.appearance: A lightning scar like a fern down one wrist; he does not blink when he is lied to.

people.role: Rain faction sword at the old tower
people.backstory: A Thu Trì ferryman's granddaughter, kin to the dead Kỷ Vãn Tình (ky_van_tinh), who guards the old tower's stair for Quan Vũ Thanh.

ties.note: the first elder
her grandmother's sister
sweeps the founder's cistern at the Rain Tower
keeper of the founder's rain-chain at the Rain Tower

people.appearance: Leans on a boat-pole as if it were a staff, in a ferryman's wide-footed stance.

people.role: Tends the lightning burns after storm drills
people.backstory: Dresses the burns after every storm drill on Liệt Khuyết Phong; she learned her salves from the healer Giả Hồi Xuân (gia_hoi_xuan) in Hạnh Hoa Thị.

ties.note: the lamp keeper
taught her salves
cone-born outer disciple who helps tend the lightning burns

people.appearance: Smells of camphor, and her apron carries every salve in the Tower.

people.role: Mạnh Lưu Ly's second disciple
people.backstory: Mạnh Lưu Ly's (manh_luu_ly) second disciple, a Không Mông girl who wants her master to be head and says so in the dining hall. She tells the Hall of Rules who in Lưu Ly's circle spoke against the head, and Phan Tích Lịch (phan_tich_lich) lost a season's stones for a remark over rice.

ties.note: the head's heir
her senior

people.appearance: Touches a silver pin whenever she wants to be believed.

people.role: Keeps Tạ Thiết Trụ's guardhouse on the new seat
people.backstory: Tạ Thiết Trụ's (ta_thiet_tru) grandson, who keeps the guardhouse on Thần Cổ Phong named for him and stands on its wall in storms as he did.

ties.note: held Thủ Lôi Bảo nine days
the vault master
they share the night watch

people.appearance: Stands bareheaded on the wall in storms, his grandfather's stance to the inch.

people.role: Courier from the old tower to the vassals
people.backstory: Carries Hứa Thanh Diêm's (hua_thanh_diem) letters to the vassal manors and has eaten a meal at Hồng Đậu Trang without dying, which she boasts of.

ties.note: the envoy
the manor mistress laughed at her boast
the Hồng Đậu steward who let her eat and live, to hear what she would say
farm girl from Phong Đăng who carries the grain tax
Quan Vũ Thanh's grand-nephew at the Rain Tower

people.appearance: A courier's satchel worn through at one corner; she will tell you about the meal at Hồng Đậu Trang before you ask.

people.role: A Sa Kim boy in Hầu Vọng Xuân's drills, with no Thunder
people.backstory: Grew up beside Khúc Thanh Điện (khuc_thanh_dien) at the gold-sand mine; his root is Metal without Fire, and he cannot forgive her the lightning.

ties.note: keeps him for his Metal
same mine, one Thunder
Young Thunder sword of the Thunder Hall

people.appearance: Gold flecks in his teeth, and one eyebrow that never rests.

people.role: Reads the storms for the drills on Liệt Khuyết Phong
people.backstory: Reads the sky for Phương Đoạn Vũ (phuong_doan_vu): he calls the drills up the peak when a storm will strike, and down when it will kill.

ties.note: the drillmaster
leads the climb he calls
cone girl admitted on Fire, who reads the clouds for the drills

people.appearance: Squints at the sky as if it owed him money, one wet finger raised.
